annotations.title: Create / revoke a public share link (PRO)

description: Create, renew or revoke a public link or QR code to one of the user's CVs, so recruiters can view it online. PRO. Creating one makes the CV viewable by anyone with the link — only on the user's explicit request; revoking takes it offline again.

action.description: revoke takes the CV offline again.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

purpose.description: A shareable link or a QR code.

name: create_takemeup_share_link
